title: Persona 4 Revival Comes to Switch 2 on May 20, 2027 — Three Months After Other Platforms
description: Persona 4 Revival launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20, 2027, while the PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC versions arrive February 18.
body:
**Persona 4 Revival is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20, 2027.** Atlus and SEGA used Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026 to lock in the Nintendo release date, which arrives roughly three months after the February 18 launch on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.

The Switch 2 version is not a stripped-down side release. SEGA lists it alongside the main platforms, and physical copies are planned for both PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

The remake itself reimagines Persona 4 Golden with upgraded graphics, UI, combat and cutscenes, while preserving the investigation, Social Links and TV World structure at the heart of the original.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Persona 4 Revival release-date artwork showing the May 20, 2027 Nintendo Switch 2 launch date.

contentBlocks.text: Nintendo has confirmed **May 20, 2027** as the release date for Persona 4 Revival on Switch 2. That date comes after the February 18 launch already set for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Windows and Steam, making Nintendo's version a later arrival rather than part of the initial February release.
contentBlocks.heading: May 20: Inaba finally comes to Switch 2

contentBlocks.text: SEGA's official product information places Nintendo Switch 2 alongside the game's main platform lineup and confirms that physical copies are available for both PlayStation 5 and Switch 2. Nothing announced so far suggests a separate or reduced content package for Nintendo players.
contentBlocks.heading: A later release, not a lesser one

contentBlocks.text: SEGA describes Persona 4 Revival as a modern reimagining of Persona 4 Golden with enhanced graphics, UI, combat and cutscenes, plus quality-of-life improvements and additional content. The goal is broader than a visual remaster: Inaba, the investigation and the TV World are all being rebuilt through a modern presentation.
contentBlocks.heading: What Persona 4 Revival is actually rebuilding

contentBlocks.text: The remake adds new combat interactions, including guarding that can stun attacking Shadows and a mechanic that can send status-affected enemies flying into one another. Familiar Persona fundamentals such as exploiting weaknesses, All-Out Attacks and Persona fusion remain central.
contentBlocks.heading: Combat gets more than a coat of paint

contentBlocks.text: The story once again follows a student arriving in rural Inaba as a series of murders and rumors surrounding the Midnight Channel pull the Investigation Team into a strange world inside televisions. SEGA is preserving that core premise while rebuilding the presentation around it.
contentBlocks.heading: The Midnight Channel still anchors the mystery

contentBlocks.text: School life is still a major half of the Persona 4 structure. Players can form Social Links, study, join activities and take part-time jobs, with relationships feeding back into Persona growth and combat progression.
contentBlocks.heading: Social Links remain part of the rhythm

contentBlocks.text: SEGA specifically lists physical editions for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2. That makes the Nintendo version notable not only as a later release, but as one of the platforms receiving a boxed edition.
contentBlocks.heading: Switch 2 gives Persona 4 Revival a physical home

contentBlocks.text: With May 20 locked in, the remaining Switch 2 questions are practical ones: performance, resolution, load times and whether Nintendo-specific features are supported. SEGA has not yet detailed those technical differences.
contentBlocks.heading: The date is settled — now the wait shifts to the port itself

quickRead: Persona 4 Revival launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20, 2027.
The PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Windows and Steam versions launch earlier on February 18, 2027.
The remake features enhanced graphics, UI, combat and cutscenes, plus quality-of-life improvements and added content.
SEGA lists physical editions for both PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.
